phrase.zh: 调准频率，听见微小的回应。
phrase.en: Tune the frequency to hear a small response.

visual.zh: 近景铜线圈从画面边缘环绕，中央放置小型球簇，细密刻线表现线圈转折，周围留出安静的空间。
visual.en: A close copper coil curves in from the edges around a small bead cluster. Fine hatching follows each turn, with quiet space around the center.

background.zh:
拉比用无线电波研究原子核的磁性。1938年的分子束实验利用磁场与无线电频率观察共振，他因此获得1944年诺贝尔物理学奖。画面以铜线圈包围小型核模型，表达频率与响应的关系；它是原创示意，不是历史设备或实测数据。短句为原创。
1944年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：使用共振方法测定原子核的磁性
background.en:
Rabi used radio waves to measure nuclear magnetism. His 1938 molecular-beam work used magnetic fields and radio frequencies to study resonance, earning the 1944 Nobel Prize in Physics. A copper coil around a small model of a nucleus expresses frequency and response. This is an original illustration, not a historical apparatus or measured data. The phrase is original.
1944 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his resonance method for recording the magnetic properties of atomic nuclei
